mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, address, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM warehouse WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, code, name, address, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM warehouse WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse (code, name, address, enabled) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{address}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse SET name = #{name}, address = #{address} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE warehouse SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled != #{enabled}
